cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

mechanism: A leads clarification and agrees to B requested subject while progressively narrowing which box details and arrival location count as honest answers.
confusable: Unlike openly refusing to answer, A says yes and offers technically narrow answers under a claim of honesty.
comparison: Donation-box location and contents differ from a birthday meal photograph.
seedUse: D143-a bank, box, money and car-park arrival; S02-a yields the topic while retaining control of definitions.
